findings.description: The KMS key does not enable automatic key rotation (enable_key_rotation is unset, defaulting to false). Without rotation, the same key material protects the audit bucket indefinitely, and CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark requires rotation of customer-managed KMS keys for data at rest.

No key policy is defined and key deletion is not protected by MFA or a strong key policy, so a principal with kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion can set the minimum 7-day deletion window and render encrypted audit data permanently unrecoverable; a restrictive key policy limiting Delete/PutKeyPolicy to a controlled admin role is the guardrail expected here.
